job.name: poppy-film
job.prompt: One continuous cinematic macro shot. The giant scarlet poppy in the foreground moves very gently in a passing breeze, its thin translucent petals flutter with physically realistic subtle motion. Distant meadow grasses sway softly. Camera makes a very slow controlled 8 percent push toward the flower. Preserve composition, blue dusk sky, red petal texture, photoreal analog film style. No new objects, no people, no text, no cuts. Intimate and almost still.
